title: eval-verdict config
description: Thresholds for eval-verdict. Unknown keys are errors: a typo must not silently weaken the gate.

model.description: Model the thresholds were set for. A report from another model is ERROR.

pass.description: Range one trial must fall in to pass. Both ends inclusive.

minPassingTrials.description: k: passing trials a case needs.

minTrials.description: n: measured (non-null) trials needed to judge at all. Fewer is ERROR.

cases.description: Per-case overrides. Every case named here must be in the report.

guards.description: Ranges for report.samples. Missing, null, or out of range is ERROR.
